findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_price_quote, get_state_hoa_rules, get_review_record, start_election_draft, create_election_draft, add_voters · Private data: get_review_record, create_election_draft · Public sink: get_price_quote, start_election_draft, get_election, add_voters, create_survey, publish_election · Destructive: get_review_record, get_governance_center_overview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_price_quote, get_state_hoa_rules, get_review_record, start_election_draft, create_election_draft, add_voters · Private data: get_review_record, create_election_draft · Public sink: get_price_quote, start_election_draft, get_election, add_voters, create_survey, publish_election · Destructive: get_review_record, get_governance_center_overview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
